summary: AnaptysBio, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a sublease agreement with First Tracks Biotherapeutics, Inc. for roughly 45,057 square feet of office/lab space in San Diego. The sublease runs 12 months from June 15, 2026, with a possible extension until April 2028. First Tracks pays monthly basic rent and additional rent equal to what AnaptysBio owes under the master lease. AnaptysBio remains primarily liable to the master landlord. This is a routine operational real estate contract, not a special situation or corporate event. No deal terms, board recommendation, or strategic changes are involved — pure facilities management.
